checked.claim: Commission FAQ answer 7.3 says the due diligence report is required from August 2027, which was not reconciled with Art. 96(2)(c) as read (Chapter VIII from 18 August 2025) or with amending Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 (not read); this affects Annex XIII point 1(d).

evidence.what_it_shows: English OJ text of Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 of 18 July 2025 (OJ L, 2025/1561, 30.7.2025) amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 as regards battery due diligence: Art. 1 replaces '18 August 2025' with '18 August 2027' in Art. 48(1) and '18 February 2025' with '26 July 2026' in Art. 48(5); it does not touch Art. 77, Art. 96 or Annex XIII.
Cellar metadata for CELEX 32025R1561: amends 32023R1542 Art. 48(1) and Art. 48(5), start of validity 2025-07-31.

EUR-Lex consolidated text 13.08.2026: Chapter VII 'Obligations of economic operators as regards battery due diligence policies'; Art. 48(1) carries marker M2 (32025R1561) and names 18 August 2027; Art. 48(5) carries M2 and names 26 July 2026; Art. 52(3) is the annual public report on the due diligence policy; Art. 96(2)(c) 'Chapter VIII shall apply from 18 August 2025' with no marker.

Second route (Cellar consolidated text): Chapter VII heading, Art. 48(1) with M2 and 18 August 2027, Art. 48(5) with M2 and 26 July 2026; Chapter VIII is 'Management of waste batteries'; Annex XIII point 1(d) refers to the report on battery due diligence policy under Art. 52(3).
FAQ answer 7.3: due diligence report required from August 2027; carbon footprint, recycled content and due diligence information not required from February 2027.

checked.correction: The tension the claim posits does not exist. Art. 96(2)(c) concerns Chapter VIII ('Management of waste batteries'), not due diligence. Due diligence is Chapter VII, whose own application date sits in Art. 48(1); Regulation (EU) 2025/1561 (M2, in force 31 July 2025) replaced '18 August 2025' with '18 August 2027' there, and the consolidated text of 13.08.2026 shows the M2 marker on Art. 48(1). FAQ answer 7.3 ('August 2027') is therefore consistent with the law as amended. Consequence for Annex XIII point 1(d): Art. 48(1) as amended states that from 18 August 2027 operators shall fulfil the due diligence obligations in Art. 48(2) and (3) and Arts 49, 50 and 52; the Art. 52(3) report that point 1(d) refers to is thus not required before 18 August 2027, so point 1(d) cannot be mandatory for passports issued between 18 February 2027 and 18 August 2027. The first agent's Art. 96(2)(c)/Chapter VIII reference should be deleted and replaced by Art. 48(1) as amended by M2.
checked.notes: The factual part of the claim (FAQ 7.3 says August 2027) is confirmed; the stated non-reconciliation and the Chapter VIII/Art. 96(2)(c) attribution are what is refuted.
